method.description: Inspect dominant skin-colored span on several horizontal scanlines, then verify against the line master and human carrying-angle structure.
method.warning: The color threshold is measurement assistance only, not a production mask or semantic separator.

selectedElbow.reason: Near the visible skin center at the estimated elbow height and inward of the shoulder-wrist chord.

correctedCenterlineFit.interpretation: The two corrected bone segments follow the centers of the visible upper-arm and forearm spans; the remaining error is small relative to the local half-width.

anatomicalInterpretation.meaning: The upper arm stays more vertical while the forearm angles outward on the screen-right arm; the bend branch no longer collapses into a straight line.
